mentions.name: SuperBlocker
mentions.description: A native ad blocker for iPhone and iPad that uses Apple's latest URL filtering technology to block URLs without revealing them to Apple's relays or SuperBlocker's servers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
SuperBlocker: https://superblocker.app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/superblocker-ad-blocker/id6799851416)

SuperBlocker is a native blocker that works on iPhone and iPad using Apple's latest URL filtering technology that blocks URLs without revealing it to Apple's relays or SuperBlocker's servers.
